g.text: Figure 2. Sensitivity of mapped flood area
Sentinel-2 event composite · 29 and 31 August 2022 · One parameter varied at a time
Tests 1–4 Control flood area 8,852.04 km² on 24,420.45 km² of valid observations.
Cloud test Control flood area 8,847.35 km² on a 24,239.81 km² common valid footprint.
Lines connect the tested outcomes. These ranges describe sensitivity to the selected settings.
The parameter ranges differ, so their effects depend on the chosen perturbations.
